Title: A Great Nation and Blessing Through Abraham
Promise: Through Abraham God would make a great nation, bless him, and bless all families of the earth in him.
Fulfillment: Galatians 3:8 states the gospel was preached beforehand to Abraham in this promise, and Galatians 3:16 identifies the Seed as Christ.

Title: The Land Promised to Abraham's Seed
Promise: God would give the land of Canaan to Abraham and his seed.
Fulfillment: Joshua 21:43-45 states the LORD gave Israel all the land he swore to give their fathers and that none of his good promises failed.

Title: A Saviour From the Seed of the Woman
Promise: The seed of the woman would bruise the serpent's head, the first promise of a deliverer after the fall.
Fulfillment: Matthew 1:22-23 states the virgin birth of Jesus fulfilled what was spoken by the prophet.

Title: God's Presence With Jacob
Promise: God would be with Jacob, keep him wherever he went, and bring him back to the land.

Title: Deliverance From Egypt
Promise: God would bring Israel out of affliction in Egypt into a land flowing with milk and honey.
Fulfillment: Exodus 14:30 states the LORD saved Israel that day out of the hand of the Egyptians.

Title: A Treasured Possession and Holy Nation
Promise: If Israel obeyed God's voice and kept his covenant, they would be his peculiar treasure above all people, a kingdom of priests and a holy nation.
Condition: If ye will obey my voice indeed, and keep my covenant.

Title: Rest in the Land
Promise: God would give Israel rest from all their enemies and a place to dwell securely.
Fulfillment: Joshua 21:44 states the LORD gave them rest round about according to all he swore to their fathers.

Title: An Everlasting House for David
Promise: God would raise up David's seed after him, establish his kingdom, and build him a house; his throne would be established for ever.
Fulfillment: Luke 1:32-33 states the Lord God would give Jesus the throne of his father David and that his kingdom would have no end.

Title: The New Covenant
Promise: God would make a new covenant, writing his law in hearts, forgiving iniquity and remembering sin no more.
Fulfillment: Hebrews 8:8-12 quotes this passage as the new covenant, and Luke 22:20 records Jesus instituting it in his blood.
FulfillmentScriptures: Hebrews 8:8; Hebrews 8:9; Hebrews 8:10; Hebrews 8:11; Hebrews 8:12; Luke 22:20

Title: Return From Exile After Seventy Years
Promise: After seventy years in Babylon, God would visit his people and bring them back to Jerusalem.
Fulfillment: Ezra 1:1-3 records Cyrus' decree for the return and the rebuilding of the house of the LORD at Jerusalem.

Title: The Outpouring of the Spirit
Promise: God would pour out his Spirit upon all flesh, and sons and daughters would prophesy.
Fulfillment: Acts 2:16-17 records Peter declaring at Pentecost, 'this is that which was spoken by the prophet Joel'.

Title: The Gift of the Holy Spirit
Promise: To those who repent and are baptized in the name of Jesus Christ, God gives the gift of the Holy Ghost, a promise to them, their children, and all afar off.
Condition: Repent, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins.

Title: Forgiveness on Confession
Promise: If we confess our sins, God is faithful and just to forgive us and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

Title: Healing and Restoration on Repentance
Promise: If God's people humble themselves, pray, seek his face, and turn from wicked ways, he will hear from heaven, forgive their sin, and heal their land.
Condition: If my people humble themselves, and pray, and seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways.

Title: Eternal Life to Believers
Promise: Whoever believes in the Son has everlasting life; God so loved the world that he gave his only begotten Son.

Title: Never Left nor Forsaken
Promise: God will never leave nor forsake his people; he goes with them and will not fail them.

Title: Peace in Trouble
Promise: Christ gives his peace, not as the world gives, and the peace of God guards hearts and minds.
Condition: In Philippians: prayer and supplication with thanksgiving, instead of anxiety.

Title: Rest for the Weary
Promise: All who labour and are heavy laden are invited to come to Christ, who will give them rest.
Condition: Come unto me; take my yoke upon you, and learn of me.

Title: Strength for the Weak
Promise: God gives power to the faint and increases strength to those with no might; those who wait upon the LORD renew their strength.

Title: Provision for Needs
Promise: Those who seek first the kingdom of God and his righteousness will have all necessary things added to them; God supplies all need according to his riches in Christ.
Condition: Seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness.

Title: Wisdom to Those Who Ask
Promise: If any lack wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives liberally and does not reproach, and it shall be given him.

Title: The Holy Spirit to Those Who Ask
Promise: A heavenly Father gives the Holy Spirit to them that ask him, as earthly fathers give good gifts to their children.

Title: Prayer According to His Will
Promise: If we ask anything according to his will, he hears us; whatever we ask in Christ's name, he will do.
Condition: Asking according to his will, in Christ's name.
KeyScriptures: Matthew 7:7; Matthew 7:8; John 14:13; John 14:14; 1 John 5:14; 1 John 5:15

Title: Comfort in Trouble
Promise: God comforts his people in all their tribulation, and the God of all comfort strengthens them to comfort others.

Title: Resurrection of the Dead
Promise: Christ is the resurrection and the life; believers will rise, the dead in Christ rising first at his coming.
KeyScriptures: John 11:25; John 11:26; 1 Corinthians 15:20; 1 Corinthians 15:21; 1 Corinthians 15:22; 1 Corinthians 15:23; 1 Thessalonians 4:16

Title: No Condemnation in Christ
Promise: There is no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus; whoever hears his word and believes has passed from death unto life.
Condition: Being in Christ Jesus; hearing and believing.

Title: Victory Over Sin and Death
Promise: Sin shall not have dominion over believers, and thanks be to God who gives the victory through Jesus Christ.

Title: Kept From Falling
Promise: God is able to keep believers from falling and to present them faultless before his glory with exceeding joy; no one can pluck them out of Christ's hand.

Title: God's Word Accomplishes Its Purpose
Promise: God's word goes forth and does not return void; it accomplishes what he pleases and prospers in the thing whereto he sent it.

Title: Refuge and Protection
Promise: He that dwells in the secret place of the most High abides under the shadow of the Almighty; God delivers and honours those who love him.
Condition: Dwelling in the secret place; loving God and knowing his name.

Title: Guidance for the Path
Promise: God's word is a lamp to feet and a light to the path; acknowledging him in all ways, he directs paths.
Condition: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; in all thy ways acknowledge him.

Title: A New Heaven and a New Earth
Promise: God will make all things new: a new heaven and a new earth, no more death, sorrow, crying, or pain, God dwelling with men.

Title: Christ's Return
Promise: Jesus will come again and receive his people to himself, descending from heaven with a shout, the voice of the archangel, and the trump of God.

Title: Healing to the Prayer of Faith
Promise: The prayer of faith shall save the sick, and the Lord shall raise him up; God is the LORD that healeth.
Condition: The prayer of faith; confession and prayer for one another (James 5:16). No promise is made about timing or manner of healing.
